feature: The measure inspector carries only measurement actions
summary: Selecting a measurement no longer offers Copy Image and Export PNG, which exported the whole document. In their place is Copy Measurement, with the exact spec line it will copy shown underneath.
setup: Photonz Dev, Experiments window, release Next, Measurements panel flag on (default). Open any screenshot.

try.do: Press I for the Measure tool and click a control to place a size measurement.
Press V and click the measurement so the Measure inspector shows.
Scroll the inspector to the bottom and read the line under the button.
Click Copy Measurement, then paste into any chat or notes field.
Rename the measurement in the Name field and watch the line under the button follow.
Press Shift Command C to copy the whole image, and Shift Command E then Return to export a PNG.

evaluate: With Export gone, does the inspector read as being only about the selected measurement?
Does the grey line under the button tell you what will land on the clipboard, or does it read as decoration?
Is one Copy Measurement button here worth having, given the row's right-click and the Measure menu already offer it?
Did you miss the two export buttons, or was the File menu where you would have looked anyway?
rough: The preview line keeps the leading dash, because that is literally what gets copied (- Width: 124 px (size)). It is honest but it can read as a bullet decoration.
A long measurement name truncates the preview line with an ellipsis rather than wrapping, to keep the section one row tall.
Export PNG used to save a 1x PNG in one click. It is now Shift Command E then Return, since the dialog opens on PNG at 1x. One extra keystroke, no lost capability.
The task said the toolbar also owns these actions. It does not: File is the only other home, and that is where they stayed.
This is a departure from the redline mock, which staged an Export section in the Properties panel. The mock put a document action under a selection.
